status: Assistant-proposed card allocation within user-approved structure; not a complete deck or applied Arena list
user_decisions: Prefer Lightning over Tyvar for safety
Deprioritize Raph & Leo for board dependence
Like Miles/Michelangelo synergy and Hexing Squelcher
Jennifer Walters reserved for sideboard; no sideboard quantity assigned

reasoning.Lightning_vs_Tyvar: First strike, trample and lifelink provide immediate solo combat quality without another untapped creature or a five-mana activation. Both have printed power three and are ineligible for Smile absent a relevant zone effect.
reasoning.Raph_and_Leo: Extra-combat synergy remains real, but no native haste/evasion/removal means lower priority for the requested independent combat quality.
reasoning.Academic: Two-power flying haste is already a pressure floor without an engine. Discard is optional, not a draw/filter effect: spend only for meaningful lifegain or useful Smile setup. Hold repeat copies until mana and pressure tests.
reasoning.Michelangelo: Three proposed because legendary and weaker standalone body. Improves each Miles target and counter engine, including Smile's post-entry counter grants.
reasoning.Hexing: Ward-life payments support damage pressure, but removing Squelcher first or using nontargeting answers limits total tax; no assumed guaranteed damage.

remaining: Four one-drop creatures, eight interaction spells, and land identities remain open. Existing four-drop and Smile reservations remain unchanged. At least one further creature copy with replenishment/additional-body production is required to satisfy the structure's four-copy resource floor; evaluate the open one-drop band (e.g. prior-researched Pawpatch Recruit offspring) before finalization, or explicitly propose a Warden/Lightning adjustment. No silent floor relaxation.
validation: Partial two/three-mana slot arithmetic only; full structure checker and complete mana/performance gates await a fully selected list.
